correctness.rationale: PASS: Actual RESULT.md reconstructs the nine Pauli correlations from the stationary Lindblad-reset commutator system, with D=(1+R²)²+4alpha²R² and F=4alpha²+R²+4. Horodecki singular-value formula plus the two-column Ky Fan lower bound yields (CHSH/2)²>=Txy²+Tzz². At alpha>=2, R=1/(2alpha), Tzz>=9/10 and |Txy|>=256/545, whose squared sum exceeds one. The R down-to-zero correlation limit has only two singular values c and 1-c with c=1/(2(1+alpha²)), so CHSH<2; the large-R expansion gives 2-2/R²+O(R^-4)<2 for fixed alpha. Direct scaling of T gives diag limit with off-diagonal magnitude 2s/(1+4s²), uniquely maximal at s=1/2. Independently reconstructed 4x4 Hamiltonian spectral Poisson integral and checked its correlation against the exact formula at six numeric pairs, including alpha=2,3,10 at their witness rates; these finite calculations do not certify the universal quantifiers.
